id.description: Stable project-unique identifier. Changing it creates a separate local runtime.

tomcatVersion.description: Exact Tomcat release. Never automatically upgraded. Tomcat 8.5 is archived by Apache.

release.description: Exact Temurin release name, for example jdk-17.0.13+11. Select using Create Instance.

jvmArgs.description: One complete JVM option per element. Managed bootstrap, logging, identity and directory properties are reserved.

debug.description: Used only by Tomcat: Debug. Start remains normal. JDWP binds to 127.0.0.1 without suspending Tomcat startup.

port.description: Distinct JDWP port. Debug automatically allocates a declared project port from 5005 when omitted.

projectName.description: Optional Java project name used by Debugger for Java for source resolution.

sourcePaths.description: Optional project-relative Java source directories. Paths cannot escape this project.

environment.description: Application environment. Use ${secret:name} for local secrets. Java/Tomcat launch variables are reserved.

hotReload.description: Optional automatic reload; absent means off. HotSwap requires an owned Java debug session; redeploy rebuilds the WAR and restarts this Tomcat.

watch.description: Project-relative globs using /, *, ** and ?. Both modes run only when .java documents are saved in VS Code; other files and filesystem change/create/delete events do not trigger reload.

exclude.description: Additional excluded globs. Build outputs/control directories are always ignored.

configDir.description: Project-relative native configuration folder. Generate with Initialize Native Configuration; do not point this at an application or project root.

libraries.description: Project-relative shared JARs copied into this instance's CATALINA_BASE/lib. File names must be distinct.

build.description: Optional managed Maven build. The original POM is preserved; a derived POM builds an isolated local WAR.

pom.description: Project-relative POM of a single WAR module.

includeProvided.description: Include declared provided JARs in WEB-INF/lib, excluding container APIs and compile-time tools.

goal.description: install also installs the derived development artifact/POM into the local Maven repository.

settings.description: Maven settings.xml file: absolute path (including outside the project) or path relative to the project. Passed with -s during model resolution and build. Omit to use Maven's default user settings.

jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments for the managed Maven process.

excludeProvidedGroups.description: Additional groupIds excluded only from automatic provided-dependency staging.

dependencies.description: Explicit missing dependency overrides, resolved by Maven using the project's dependency management.

source.description: Project-relative WAR file or application directory. Junctions and symbolic links are not supported.

context.description: Use / for ROOT, or a context such as /app.
